sourceTitle: Watch and Wait; or, The Young Fugitives
description: "Watch and Wait; or, The Young Fugitives" by Oliver Optic is a novel written in the late 19th century. This engaging story revolves around young characters entangled in the complex and often dangerous world of antebellum slavery.
